listing.name: Nightcross Armory Corporation
listing.summary: This is a faction I've been working on for some time. I first started modding back in 2019, before going on hiatus and coming back around 0.97, at which point I found out to my amazement that my source code mostly still worked!
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with exploration content, unique ships, and specialized weapons.

description:
Can be added to existing saves, but certain exploration content will not generate. Can not be removed from a save.

Dependencies:
LunaLib
GraphicsLib
MagicLib
LazyLib

Optional:
Custom Battle Music (contains custom tracks)
Second in Command (features two new XO types)

This is a faction I've been working on for some time. I first started modding back in 2019, before going on hiatus and coming back around 0.97, at which point I found out to my amazement that my source code mostly still worked! It's since expanded into exploration content inspired by certain abyssal encounters in .98.

This mod contains zero AI generated content. All images, music, and code were created by humans (and me, your local friendly robot girl). Many of the features can be turned off, including wandering [VERY_REDACTED] fleets, Nightcross Armory as an independent faction, and the mod's weapons being found in salvage.

Contains:

Exploration content with unique ships and weapons (including abyss encounters)
A minor faction with one capital, three cruisers, three destroyers, and three frigates. Generally high tech with light armor, high movement speed, high flux capacity, but relatively low flux dissipation, offset by a universal hullmod for shielded ships that reduces flux costs when shields are off for a high risk/reward playstyle. Some faster ships lose their zero-flux bonus when they sustain hull damage, in exchange for powerful movement abilities.
5 fighter LPCs
About 30 or so factional weapons, including 3 types of missiles and a bunch of energy, synergy, and hybrid types. Energy weapons generally deal less damage with worse efficiency than most energy weapons, but longer range.
Several modular hullmods
A star system with independent/pirate markets including special submarkets that sell NCA gear (since they don't have any official market)
Graphicslib integration (normal maps only), plus fancy lights and doodads.
Two Second-in-Command XOs, one hidden and one available from the start.
Should be safe to add to existing saves, not to remove ofc.

Some action shots

Lo Sulci

Corrosion Torpedo

COMSEC REDACTED

aiDescription: Introduces a high-tech faction featuring capital ships, cruisers, destroyers, and frigates with a high-risk, high-reward playstyle focused on movement and flux management. Includes exploration content inspired by abyssal encounters, modular hullmods, and a star system with independent markets selling factional gear. The mod also adds fighter LPCs, numerous weapons, and integration with GraphicsLib for visual effects.
